title: Giving away 24 fully animated creatures made with Warp Studio
author: Crockiestar
selftext:
Hey everyone, I’m the developer of **Warp Studio**.

I wanted to share **4 free creature packs** to show the kind of animations you can make with it pretty quickly if you already have character art ready.

Each pack has **6 creatures**, and each creature comes with **7 animations**:  
**walk, attack, sustain damage, run, breathe, dance, and interact**

Warp Studio works by using **smart mesh deformation** to animate characters from still images, so you can get a lot of motion out of existing art without drawing every frame by hand. Alot of these Animations can be made in 1 click by using an Animation Preset. You can also mix that with **AI-generated frames** for things like attacks or impact poses, which makes it possible to build out full animation sets pretty fast.

These packs are mainly meant to show that workflow in action. If you already have your characters ready, you can make animations like these very quickly in Warp Studio, and there are also a lot more animation presets in the app beyond the ones shown here. 

Check out Warp Studio here:

[https://warpstudio.app/](https://warpstudio.app/)

Here are the 4 free packs:

* [pack1](https://crockiestar.itch.io/6-fully-animated-creatures-asset-pack-3)
* [pack2](https://crockiestar.itch.io/animated-creatures-of-infinity-asset-pack-2)
* [pack3](https://crockiestar.itch.io/animated-creatures-of-infinity-asset-pack-1)
* [pack4](https://crockiestar.itch.io/6-fully-animated-creatures-asset-pack-4)
